label: CodeBuddy Code Access
description: A CodeBuddy login, for the CodeBuddyCode nodes' `access`: a CodeBuddy API key. One access for however many CodeBuddyCode nodes. A key from the China site needs the node's `edition` set to `internal`.

steps: Open codebuddy.ai, your profile's API keys, and create a key (a China account: its own console).
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that account.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the CodeBuddyCode nodes' `access` input.
